name: publicWeb_getRunPack
description: A signed-in web member's own state for a run and who else is coming (E9.F7.S4) — the first member-only content on the public web. Gated on any valid device token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 109, @param NULL), because the pack list is what the app shows any signed-in hasher on the RSVP tab; no kennel permission. The run must exist and be live (deleted = 0, removed = 0; IsVisible is not checked). The pack is hares, RSVP yes / maybe and anyone checked in — never the 'not coming' rows — hares first, then attended, then yes, then maybe, then by name. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for this SP (ValidateAppAuth spNumber 109). No SQL default.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: The run. No SQL default; unknown or deleted → 1200.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a ValidateAppAuth failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1; the SP RETURNs.
Error detail after the AuthErrorEnvelope (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: NotFoundEnvelope
rowsets.description: Run not found or deleted / removed: { success = 0, errorCode = 1200, errorType = 12 } then the detail at index 1 (logged to HC.ErrorLog); RETURN.
After NotFoundEnvelope: 1200 / 12, 'Run not found', 'That run could not be found.' (no debugMessage column).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success, before the data rowsets: { success = 1, errorCode = NULL, errorType = NULL }.

rowsets.name: Me
rowsets.description: On success: one row for the caller (zero if their HC.Hasher row is gone).

columns.name: isPast
columns.description: 1 when EventStartDatetimeGmt is before now (no 6-hour grace, unlike publicWeb_getMyRuns' IsPast).

rowsets.name: Pack
rowsets.description: On success: one row per live hasher with IsHare = 1, RsvpState 2 / 3, or AttendenceState >= 20 on the run; ORDER BY IsHare DESC, attended, yes, maybe, name.

columns.name: name
columns.description: COALESCE(NULLIF(HasherEventMap.DisplayName, ''), Hasher.DisplayName, HashName, '') — the per-run name first.

columns.name: photo
columns.description: COALESCE(NULLIF(HasherKennelMap.KennelUserPhoto, ''), Hasher.Photo, '') — may be a bundle:// avatar; the web skips non-http values.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the 1200 not-found path and in the CATCH (then THROW).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken and @publicEventId have no SQL default (lines 2-4). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

codeSmells.issue: Internal hasher ids sent to the browser
codeSmells.detail: Rowsets 1 and 2 return HC.Hasher.id (lines 71, 83) where /hc-primary-keys reserves PublicHasherId for identification outside the server. publicWeb_getEventRunners already exposes the same ids for PackTrack, so this widens nothing today, but it is the pattern the key strategy says to avoid.
The run lookup (line 52) does not check IsVisible, so a signed-in member with the PublicEventId of a hidden run sees its pack.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
